project.contextReadScope: Main Agent read orchestration-scope files only. Sub-Agents read constraint files (page-rendering-quality-gate, shared-page-rendering-kernel, visual-experience-guidelines, html-rendering-primitives) directly per shared-page-rendering-kernel Phase 0+1.

lowValueCallWatchdog.noProgressNextAction: If a page dispatch fails after retry, fall back to in-context generation per 02-page-composition.md Step 3.1. Do not enter extended thinking loops.

project.designRead: mobile health app / elderly Parkinson's patients + caregivers / clinical-trust teal + functional status colors / info-dense but progressive disclosure / avoid high cognitive load and small touch targets
project.styleDefinitionBrief: Medical-grade mobile UI for elderly Parkinson's patients. Teal primary (#0d9488) with semantic status colors (green/amber/red/orange). Outfit + GeistMono. 56px touch targets, 17px body baseline, WCAG 2.1 AA. Calm, trustworthy, low cognitive load.

mobileNavigation.activeState: primary icon+label color only; geometry stays identical

structure.navClass: w-full bg-[var(--surface)] border-t border-[var(--border)] flex items-end
structure.innerClass: w-full max-w-[390px] mx-auto grid grid-cols-3 h-[64px]
structure.itemClass: min-w-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1 px-1 h-full
structure.activeRule: only color/font-weight/data-active may change; no class changes that affect layout

sharedProjectShellContract.surfaceDepthModel: Cards use --shadow-card (alpha 0.08). Floating layers (modals, sheets) use --shadow-modal (alpha 0.15). Static surfaces are border-led.

pages.title: 今日仪表盘
pages.visualNorthStar: Calm clinical dashboard. Large tremor amplitude number as hero, 24h mini sparkline, medication timeline with color-coded nodes, conditional alert + AI insight cards. Green ON-state theme. Progressive disclosure: core info ≤5 items per screen.
pages.compositionPattern: vertical-stack: status bar → tremor status hero card → medication timeline → conditional alert → AI insight → bottom tab spacer
continuityAnchors: teal primary #0d9488 with semantic status colors

pages.title: 趋势分析
pages.visualNorthStar: Data-driven trend page. Large amplitude line chart with ON/OFF color bands and medication markers. 2x3 statistics grid. Annotated event list. Segmented time range selector at top.
pages.compositionPattern: vertical-stack: segmented control → main chart (50%) → stats grid 2x3 → event list → bottom tab spacer
continuityAnchors: teal primary #0d9488 with semantic status colors
chartsRequired: amplitude line chart with ON/OFF bands (inline SVG)
medication markers as vertical dashed lines
